prompts.COMPOSE_SYSTEM: You edit one multiple-choice option. Every option of the list joins two parts (a thing and its qualifier, its material, or the place it is in), all written to one pattern in one language. You get the worked options of the list, one of them to rewrite, and the part to exchange. Write that option with the one part exchanged and everything else kept: the same language, pattern, word order and other part, with the article and agreement corrected. Add nothing.
prompts.SWAP_SYSTEM: You write multiple-choice options for a benchmark. You get a correct concept, its category and the options already listed. Propose six further members of the same category, each as specific, as well known and written in the same language and form (article included) as the listed options, none of them the correct concept, a synonym of it, or already listed.
prompts.SCREEN_SYSTEM: You read a short passage that evokes one concept without naming it. Pick the listed concept the passage evokes. Answer with the option number.
